priorityList: Cast Ebon Might if it has 4 or less seconds remaining on its duration.
Cast Breath of Eons on cooldown.
Cast Prescience on cooldown.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1.
Cast Tip the Scales on cooldown.
Cast Upheaval on cooldown.
Cancel the Tip the Scales buff if Upheaval is not available within the next GCD to maximize Temporal Burst uptime.
Cast Hover if you need to move.
Cast Eruption if Ebon Might is up or you have two charges of Essence Burst.
Cast Blistering Scales if it is not currently active on a tank.
Cast Azure Strike for movement if Hover is unavailable.
Cast Blistering Scales during downtime when no enemies are available.
Maintain Prescience on two high-priority damage dealers at all times.
Cast Ebon Might whenever it is available to maintain primary buff uptime.
Apply Blistering Scales to the active tank to deal thorns-style damage to surrounding enemies.
Cast Breath of Eons when Ebon Might is active and the party is beginning their burst window.
Cast Upheaval at Empower Level 1 to trigger Aftershocks and extend Ebon Might via Interweave.
Cast Fire Breath at Empower Level 1 to trigger the Interweave extension for Ebon Might.
Cast Eruption to spend Essence and Essence Burst procs to further extend Ebon Might.
Cast Azure Strike as your primary filler to generate Essence and deal multi-target damage.
